purpose: Arranges items in equal columns that drop as space runs out, so it is responsive without breakpoints.

props.name: columns
props.description: Most columns to show; defaults to 3

props.name: minItemWidth
props.description: Narrowest an item may get before a column drops: sm 240px for KPI tiles, md 320px (default) for cards

whenToUse: KPI tiles, card collections and other sets of equal items
Two-column field pairs such as city and postcode
whenNotToUse: For a single row of buttons — use a horizontal Stack
For data with rows and columns — use Table
antiPatterns: Placing items of very different importance in equal cells

anatomy: A CSS grid of equal columns

a11yNotes: Purely visual: adds no role; reading order follows source order
